summary: Backend state API passed all focused tests. Frontend dashboard and most navigation/session screens render, but prepare lesson is blocked by a decorative overlay and Mark all present only marks one student.

ui_bugs.issue: The decorative .next-card:after pseudo-element intercepts pointer events, so Prepare lesson cannot be clicked normally; forced click also did not navigate at tablet width.

integration_issues.issue: After clicking Mark all present for 8 students, the UI showed 1/8 marked. setAttendance calls save repeatedly with the same stale state closure, so only the last update survives.
Add student, archive, add subject, and subject menu controls have no handlers; required management flows are not implemented. Delete invokes window.confirm and is not a custom confirmation UI.
New assignment and Save grades controls have no handlers, so rendered tabs are not connected to persistence.

issues: Sidebar collapses to icon-only controls without visible labels; accessible names rely only on button text that is visually hidden by CSS.

action_items: Remove pointer-event interception from the next-card decorative pseudo-element and re-test Prepare lesson at desktop/tablet.
Batch attendance updates from the current state (or use a functional state update) so Mark all present persists every student.
Implement student add/edit/archive, subject add/edit/archive/delete, assignment creation, and grade saving handlers and confirmation flows.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js concentrates the entire application and seed data in one large module, making state update races and unimplemented controls easy to miss.
save() performs a fire-and-forget PUT and displays Saved before API failure is known; API errors are silently swallowed with no user error state.
The calendar Day/Month buttons only change the heading; the rendered board remains the same five-column week layout.
seed_data_creation: Added and removed one TEST_round_trip note during API persistence testing; no lasting seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: State GET/PUT and validation pass. Dashboard loads at desktop and tablet; today-session navigation, session tabs, student search/profile, and subject rendering were exercised. Prepare lesson overlay and attendance bulk update need priority retesting; management CRUD remains untested because controls have no handlers.
rca of the issue: Prepare lesson is covered by a positioned .next-card:after decorative element with no pointer-events:none, which sits above the button and intercepts clicks. Attendance uses setAttendance inside forEach, while each save closes over the same state snapshot; repeated writes replace one another, leaving only one attendance record. Several required controls are JSX buttons without onClick implementations.
